row_semantics.inventory_count: null means the authoritative count for every managed environment has not been supplied
row_semantics.environment_owner: null means no authoritative managed-environment owner attestation exists in the repository or current GitHub configuration
row_semantics.deletion_commit: null means no deletion has occurred; the exact deleting commit is required before the corresponding legacy record or writer is closed
row_semantics.production_callers: paths are live production callers or composition owners proven by source scan; an empty list is deliberate and does not imply a deployed durable binding

release_constraints: No store may enter cutover until every managed environment has a resolved location, count, owner, and backup evidence.
Unversioned cursor, iteration-checkpoint, and artifact-index JSON requires an explicit legacy reader only in the offline migrator; it cannot remain an active runtime fallback.
A non-empty NEWS_DATABASE_DSN selects PostgreSQL; otherwise event and replay storage resolve below NEWS_ARTIFACT_ROOT or .newsroom/runs.
Local defaults do not prove production topology and must not be used to authorize deletion.

Harness side-effect authority, dynamic TaskPlan state, subagent attempt bundles, Graph result payloads/lineage, result quota/cache/attempt state, Graph artifact governance ledger, physical lifecycle state, and the Graph artifact catalog are explicit cutover inputs; a generic artifact-index row is not sufficient inventory evidence for their schemas or identities.

LocalJsonArtifactCatalog, SQLiteGraphResultStore schema 2, FilesystemGraphArtifactLifecycle, and GraphArtifactGovernanceRuntime now have explicit Research production composition. Write, GC, and rollout authority remains mode-gated; the repository default remains shadow and empty local defaults are not deployment evidence, so managed-environment activation and inventory remain required.

research-graph-artifact-cutover and graph-artifact-cost-retention are archived locally after implementing the catalog, SQLite quota/cache/attempt/governance store, ResultMaterializer, Tool/SubAgent producers, Research committer, artifact context loading, physical lifecycle, cost reporting, alerts, production composition, and operator surface. Their repository implementation and passing tests do not establish deployed store locations, counts, owners, backups, maintenance windows, retention-window completion, rollback authority, or legacy-writer removal.
